text_en: Then Moses and the elders of Israel charged all the people as follows: Keep the entire commandment that I am commanding you today.
text_cn: 梅瑟与以色列的长老吩咐人民说：“你们应遵守我今天吩咐你们的一切命令。

text_en: On the day that you cross over the Jordan into the land that the Lord your God is giving you, you shall set up large stones and cover them with plaster.
text_cn: 在你们过约但河，进入上主你的天主赐给你的土地的那一天，应竖立几块大石，涂上石灰；

text_en: You shall write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over, to enter the land that the Lord your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as the Lord , the God of your ancestors, promised you.
text_cn: 在你过河进入上主你的天主赐给你的地方，即上主你祖先的天主许给你的流奶流蜜的地方之后，要立即将这法律的一切话刻在上面。

text_en: So when you have crossed over the Jordan, you shall set up these stones, about which I am commanding you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall cover them with plaster.
text_cn: 所以，你们一过了约但河，就该照我今日吩咐你们的，在厄巴耳山上竖立这些石头，涂上石灰；

text_en: And you shall build an altar there to the Lord your God, an altar of stones on which you have not used an iron tool.
text_cn: 并在那里给上主你的天主建筑一座祭坛，一座未用斧凿的石头修的祭坛；

text_en: You must build the altar of the Lord your God of unhewn stones. Then offer up burnt offerings on it to the Lord your God,
text_cn: 应用未加人工的石头建筑上主你的天主的祭坛，在上面给上主你的天主奉献全燔祭，

text_en: make sacrifices of well-being, and eat them there, rejoicing before the Lord your God.
text_cn: 祭献和平祭，并在那里设宴，在上主你的天主面前欢乐。

text_en: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very clearly.
text_cn: 在这些石头上，应清清楚楚刻上这法律的一切话。”

text_en: Then Moses and the levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying: Keep silence and hear, O Israel! This very day you have become the people of the Lord your God.
text_cn: 梅瑟和肋未司祭对全以色列人说：“以色列人！你们应静默细听：你今天既成了上主你的天主的人民，

text_en: Therefore obey the Lord your God, observing his commandments and his statutes that I am commanding you today.
text_cn: 就应听从上主你的天主的话，遵行我今日给你吩咐的上主的诫命和法令。”

text_en: The same day Moses charged the people as follows:
text_cn: 梅瑟在那一天又吩咐人民说：

text_en: When you have crossed over the Jordan, these shall stand on Mount Gerizim for the blessing of the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
text_cn: “你们过了约但河以后，应站在革黎斤山上祝福人民的，是西默盎、肋未、犹大、依撒加尔、若瑟和本雅明；

text_en: And these shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
text_cn: 站在厄巴耳山上宣布诅咒的，是勒乌本、加得、阿协尔、则步隆、丹和纳斐塔里。

text_en: Then the Levites shall declare in a loud voice to all the Israelites:
text_cn: 肋未人应大声向所有的以色列人喊说：

text_en: “Cursed be anyone who makes an idol or casts an image, anything abhorrent to the Lord , the work of an artisan, and sets it up in secret. ” All the people shall respond, saying, “Amen! ”
text_cn: 那制造上主所憎恶的雕像或铸像，并将匠人的作品，放在暗处的人，是可咒骂的。全体人民应答说：阿们。

text_en: “Cursed be anyone who dishonors father or mother. ” All the people shall say, “Amen! ”
text_cn: 蔑视父亲和母亲的，是可咒骂的。全体人民应答说：阿们。

text_en: “Cursed be anyone who moves a neighbor’s boundary marker. ” All the people shall say, “Amen! ”
text_cn: 移动邻人地界的，是可咒骂的。全体人民应答说：阿们。

text_en: “Cursed be anyone who misleads a blind person on the road. ” All the people shall say, “Amen! ”
text_cn: 领瞎子走错路的，是可咒骂的。全体人民应答说：阿们。

text_en: “Cursed be anyone who deprives the alien, the orphan, and the widow of justice. ” All the people shall say, “Amen! ”
text_cn: 侵犯外方人、孤儿和寡妇权利的，是可咒骂的。全体人民应答说：阿们。

text_en: “Cursed be anyone who lies with his father’s wife, because he has violated his father’s rights. ” All the people shall say, “Amen! ”
text_cn: 与父亲的妻子同寝的，是可咒骂的，因为他揭开了父亲的衣襟。全体人民应答说：阿们。

text_en: “Cursed be anyone who lies with any animal. ” All the people shall say, “Amen! ”
text_cn: 与兽交合的，是可咒骂的。全体人民应答说：阿们。

text_en: “Cursed be anyone who lies with his sister, whether the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother. ” All the people shall say, “Amen! ”
text_cn: 与同父异母，或同母异父的姊妹同寝的，是可咒骂的。全体人民应答说：阿们。

text_en: “Cursed be anyone who lies with his mother-in-law. ” All the people shall say, “Amen! ”
text_cn: 与岳母同寝的，是可咒骂的。全体人民应答说：阿们。

text_en: “Cursed be anyone who strikes down a neighbor in secret. ” All the people shall say, “Amen! ”
text_cn: 暗杀邻人的，是可咒骂的。全体人民应答说：阿们。

text_en: “Cursed be anyone who takes a bribe to shed innocent blood. ” All the people shall say, “Amen! ”
text_cn: 接受贿赂去杀害无辜的，是可咒骂的。全体人民应答说：阿们。

text_en: “Cursed be anyone who does not uphold the words of this law by observing them. ” All the people shall say, “Amen! ”
text_cn: 不坚持这法律的话而执行的，是可咒骂的。全体人民应答说：阿们。
